title: Clone URL allow-list accepts only safe shapes
scenario: Call cloneUrlProblem with https://h/r.git, http://h/r, ssh://git@h/r, git@host:org/r.git, then ext::sh -c 'x', fd::3, file:///x, '-oProxy', 'a b', https://u:pw@h/r.
expected: The first four return undefined; ext::, fd::, file://, leading '-', whitespace/control chars and URLs with a password each return a specific message string; isAllowedCloneUrl mirrors the result.

title: redactUrl strips credentials from bare URLs and free text
scenario: redactUrl on 'fatal: https://user:tok@host/r.git failed', a URL with only user@, an ssh:// URL, text with two URLs, and scp-like git@host:path.
expected: Every scheme://user[:pw]@ becomes scheme://; text without userinfo is unchanged; scp-like form is left as is. redactUrl is touched in scripts/test-workflow-input-trust.cjs.

title: Missing-branch detection compares branch as plain text
scenario: Feed stderr variants ('Remote branch X not found in upstream origin', 'warning: Could not find remote branch', "pathspec 'x' did not match") and branch names such as 'feature/(x' and 'a+b'.
expected: Known wordings return true; unrelated stderr false; special-character branch names neither throw nor match wrong text ('a+b' vs 'aab'). Partly exercised in scripts/test-git-ready-tenant-folder-structure.cjs.

title: describeGitFailure maps ENOENT, timeout and redacts messages
scenario: Pass {code:'ENOENT'}, {killed:true}, an Error whose message holds https://u:p@h/r, and a plain string.
expected: ENOENT gives GitNotFoundError mentioning PATH; killed gives a timeout message in minutes; credentials removed; a clean Error is returned as the same object. Touched in scripts/test-workflow-input-trust.cjs.

title: cloneRepository refuses unsafe URL before spawning git
scenario: Stub child_process.execFile; call cloneRepository with 'ext::sh -c x' and with https://u:pw@h/r, then with a valid URL with and without a branch.
expected: Unsafe URLs throw 'Unsupported git URL' with redacted URL and execFile is not called; valid call carries -c protocol.ext.allow=never and protocol.fd.allow=never before 'clone', '--' before the url, and '--branch <b>' only when a branch is given.

title: Missing remote branch surfaces BranchNotFoundError
scenario: Stub execFile to reject with stderr 'Remote branch dev not found in upstream origin' when a branch is passed, and with a generic failure when it is not.
expected: Branch case throws BranchNotFoundError(branch,url) with redacted URL in the message; other failures go through describeGitFailure; without a branch BranchNotFoundError is never thrown.

title: Emptiness and containment helpers
scenario: isFolderEmpty on a missing dir, a dir with only .reltio-ide/.DS_Store/Thumbs.db, a dir with a file, and a readDirectory throwing EACCES; isPathContainedIn with sibling prefix '/ws2' vs '/ws' and a trailing slash root.
expected: Missing and ignored-only dirs are empty; a real file is non-empty; EACCES propagates (not treated as empty); '/ws2/x' is not inside '/ws'; root itself is contained. Covered in scripts/test-git-repository-source.cjs.

title: Path containment is case-insensitive only on win32
scenario: Stub process.platform to win32 then linux; compare Uri paths '/c:/Ws' vs '/C:/ws/Env/T' and '/c:/WS2'.
expected: win32: differently cased drive/folder is contained, sibling prefix is not; linux: case difference is not contained. Separator is always '/' because Uri.path is used.

title: Enclosing repository found by walking up, bounded
scenario: In memory-fs create /ws/.git and call findEnclosingGitRepository on /ws/env/tenant; repeat with no .git anywhere and with a drive-root style '/c:/x'.
expected: Returns the /ws URI when present; undefined when none and at a drive root, with no infinite loop (max 64 steps). Covered in scripts/test-git-ready-tenant-folder-structure.cjs.

title: Tenant folder cloneable only when nothing user-owned exists
scenario: memory-fs: missing folder; folder with only generated README.md files in component dirs plus .reltio-ide; folder with BusinessConfig.json; extra file beside a README; readDirectory throwing a non-ENOENT error.
expected: Missing and README-only trees are cloneable; any real file anywhere gives false; non-ENOENT errors propagate. Covered in scripts/test-git-ready-tenant-folder-structure.cjs.

title: Dirty-worktree detection fails safe
scenario: Stub git runner: non-repo folder; repo with empty 'status --porcelain'; repo with output; repo where git throws.
expected: Non-repo false; clean false; output true; git failure returns true (assume dirty so migration is refused).

title: Bind clones into an empty tenant folder and writes marker
scenario: Stub git and fs: empty tenant folder, valid https URL, branch 'dev', remote has the branch.
expected: Outcome {kind:'cloned',branch:'dev'}; component tree materialized; tenant identity marker written; .gitignore holds marker, .reltio/ and .reltio-ide/; confirmCreateBranch not called.

title: Bind adopts a populated folder without overwriting files
scenario: Tenant folder holds Business Config/BusinessConfig.json and is not a repo; stub git recording args; remote has the branch. Repeat with a folder that already has .git.
expected: Runs init -b, remote add origin, fetch origin <b>, reset origin/<b> (mixed, never --hard), set-upstream-to; outcome 'adopted'; BusinessConfig.json bytes unchanged; existing .git throws 'already a Git repository'.

title: Declining branch creation leaves folder untouched
scenario: Remote branch missing; confirmCreateBranch returns false, once on the clone path and once on the adopt path. Then true with push failing, and with an empty remote.
expected: Declined: outcome 'declined', no marker or tree written, adopt path deletes the .git it created. Confirmed: branch-created, branch-created-not-pushed (push failure) or initialized-empty-remote, with no data loss.

title: New branch forks from default and drops other tenant's config
scenario: Clone path, branch absent, default branch has Business Config/BusinessConfig.json; stub git.
expected: checkout -b <branch>, then git rm of BUSINESS_CONFIG_FILE (staged, not committed), then push -u origin; a git rm failure is ignored; component folders and READMEs untouched.

title: Git not installed gives an actionable error on bind
scenario: Make the git executable fail with ENOENT during bindTenantToGit on an empty folder.
expected: Rejects with GitNotFoundError telling the user to install Git; no marker is written and no existing tenant data is deleted.

title: Marker reader accepts legacy and multi-source, rejects malformed
scenario: Write marker JSON: legacy single object, {sources:[valid,valid]}, {sources:[valid,{tenantId:1}]}, invalid JSON, missing file.
expected: Legacy wraps into {sources:[x]}; valid multi returned as is; any invalid entry, bad JSON or missing file gives undefined without throwing; readGitSourceMarker returns the first source or undefined for an empty list.

title: Gitignore updates are idempotent and non-destructive
scenario: Run ensureMarkerGitignored on a missing .gitignore, on one with '.reltio-ide' (no slash) and CRLF endings, and on one without trailing newline; run twice.
expected: File created when absent; alternate spellings not duplicated; unrelated lines preserved; newline inserted before appending; second run writes nothing. Workspace variant adds .reltio-ide-backup/. Partly covered in scripts/test-git-ready-tenant-folder-structure.cjs (9.5).

title: Tenant and environment identity markers round-trip
scenario: Write a tenant marker {kind:'tenant',environmentName,tenantId} then read it; same for an environment marker; read in a folder with no marker.
expected: Values round-trip exactly; write also updates .gitignore; absent marker gives undefined.

title: Migration plan lists only present legacy files and never clobbers
scenario: memory-fs tenant with only L3.reltio.json and history/; another whose destination already exists; another already on the component tree.
expected: Moves list only present legacy entries; an existing destination is skipped; a migrated tree yields empty moves. Covered in scripts/test-git-ready-tenant-folder-structure.cjs (9.6).

title: Migration backs up first and stamps only on success
scenario: Legacy tenant with config, baseline, layout and history; run migrateTenant with a Memento stub. Then make fs.rename throw for one move and re-run.
expected: Backup under .reltio-ide-backup/<env>/<tenant> exists before any move; files land at new paths byte-identical; stamp is set only after all moves; rename failure returns 'move-failed' with no stamp so the next run retries.

title: Dirty worktree or failed backup blocks migration
scenario: Stub hasUncommittedChanges true; separately make the backup fs.copy throw.
expected: Returns skip reason 'dirty-worktree' or 'backup-failed' with detail; no files moved, no stamp, legacy files intact.

title: Migration is idempotent on an already migrated workspace
scenario: Run migrateWorkspace twice over a workspace with one legacy tenant and one component-tree tenant.
expected: First run reports migrated=1 with backupRoot; second run reports migrated=0, no skips, backupRoot undefined, file contents unchanged. Partly covered in scripts/test-git-ready-tenant-folder-structure.cjs.

title: Suffixed folders renamed with markers written first
scenario: Workspace with '361.reltio.com.reltio.environment/abc.reltio.tenant'; add cases where the short label folder already exists, and a dirty tenant.
expected: Tenant marker written before rename; tenant renamed to 'abc'; env renamed to short label or full host if label is taken; dirty tenant skipped and its environment folder not renamed. Covered in scripts/test-git-ready-tenant-folder-structure.cjs.

title: Undo restores legacy files from backup and clears stamps
scenario: Migrate a tenant, then call undoMigration; also call it with no backup folder.
expected: Legacy files restored with original bytes, migrated copies removed, stamp cleared so the next activation reconsiders; no backup returns restored=[] and touches nothing. No existing test.

title: Cleanup failures never block activation
scenario: Make pruneRetiredComponentFolders or materializeTenantTree throw for one tenant, and make readDirectory of the workspace root throw inside renameSuffixedFolders.
expected: migrateWorkspace still resolves with a report; other tenants are processed; no exception reaches the caller.

title: Prune removes only generated-only retired folders
scenario: Retired folders: one with a generated README only, one with a user file, one with a user-edited README; prune twice; re-run materializeTenantTree over a user README.
expected: Only the generated-only folder is removed; user content kept; second prune returns []; user README never overwritten. Covered in scripts/test-git-ready-tenant-folder-structure.cjs.

title: Tenant paths use forward slashes on Windows and POSIX
scenario: tenantPath(root,'Business Config/BusinessConfig.json') for roots file:///c%3A/ws/env/t and file:///home/u/ws; isTenantConfigPath with backslash and forward-slash fsPaths.
expected: Result is Uri.joinPath of segments (no doubled or backslash separators), folder names with spaces preserved; isTenantConfigPath recognizes both separator styles.

title: Component tree constants stay stable
scenario: Assert BUSINESS_CONFIG_FILE, IDE_STATE_DIR, BASELINE_FILE, LAYOUT_FILE, MIGRATION_BACKUP_DIR values, that every COMPONENT_FOLDERS entry has a docsUrl, and none also appears in RETIRED_COMPONENT_FOLDERS.
expected: Names match the documented git layout; renaming one is caught because it would orphan user repositories. Partly asserted in scripts/test-git-ready-tenant-folder-structure.cjs.
